fields.why: Age-adjusted rates by race/ethnicity are ranked (Black 'higher than that among all other racial and ethnic groups'), and the Table chi-squares test period by race (5 groups) and by age (3 groups) with one shared p-value each.
Race/ethnicity and age are the SPD margins with 3 or more groups; sex has 2.
The Table chi-squares are omnibus; the race-specific rate ranking has no test (ratios hand-computed), so side by side with finer contrasts; the mechanical flag is a false alarm (different results).
